description: This file contains PyTorch memory management functions specific to the 'XPU' device, including cache management, memory stats retrieval, snapshotting, and allocator customization. It defines functions for clearing cache, obtaining memory usage metrics, configuring memory fractions, taking detailed memory snapshots, recording memory history, and managing custom allocators.

classes.name: _XPUAllocator
classes.description: A wrapper class for internal XPU memory allocators, allowing encapsulation of allocator objects and providing access to the underlying allocator.

classes.name: XPUPluggableAllocator
classes.description: A class that loads a custom XPU memory allocator from a shared library, enabling user-defined allocation and free functions, and integrating with the PyTorch memory management system.

methods.name: None empty_cache()
methods.description: Releases all unoccupied cached XPU memory to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None reset_peak_memory_stats(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Resets peak memory statistics for the specified device.

methods.name: None reset_accumulated_memory_stats(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Resets the accumulated (historical) memory statistics for the device.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] memory_stats_as_nested_dict(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Returns the memory statistics as a nested dictionary.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] memory_stats(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with detailed XPU memory allocator statistics.

methods.name: int memory_allocated(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Returns the current allocated memory in bytes.

methods.name: int max_memory_allocated(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Returns the peak allocated memory in bytes since the last reset.

methods.name: int memory_reserved(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Returns the current reserved memory in bytes.

methods.name: int max_memory_reserved(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Returns the peak reserved memory in bytes since the last reset.

methods.name: tuple[int,int] mem_get_info(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Returns the total and free memory available on the device.

methods.name: float get_per_process_memory_fraction(device: Device = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the current memory fraction setting for the process on a specific device.

methods.name: None set_per_process_memory_fraction(fraction: float, device: Device = None)
methods.description: Sets a limit on the fraction of total device memory that the process can use.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] memory_snapshot( mempool_id: tuple[int, int] | None = None, )
methods.description: Returns a detailed snapshot of the XPU memory allocator state.

methods.name: _snapshot(device: Device = None, augment_with_fx_traces: bool = False)
methods.description: Captures the current memory state snapshot, optionally augmenting with FX trace info.

methods.name: None _dump_snapshot( filename: str = "dump_snapshot.pickle", augment_with_fx_traces: bool = False )
methods.description: Saves a pickled snapshot of the memory state to a file.

methods.name: None _record_memory_history( enabled: Literal["state", "all"] | None = "all", context: Literal["state", "alloc", "all"] | None = "all", stacks: Literal["python", "all"] = "all", max_entries: int = sys.maxsize, clear_history: bool = False, skip_actions: list[str] | None = None, )
methods.description: Enables recording of memory allocation and free event traces for debugging.

methods.name: None change_current_allocator(allocator: _XPUAllocator)
methods.description: Replaces the current memory allocator with a user-provided custom allocator.

methods.name: _XPUAllocator _get_current_allocator()
methods.description: Returns the currently active XPU memory allocator.
